# Jim Thompson

> > Jim Thompson offers luxury Thai silk fashion, accessories, and home décor celebrating heritage craftsmanship and contemporary design.

Founded by American entrepreneur Jim Thompson, the brand revitalized Thai silk weaving traditions. Collections feature signature silk twill scarves, shawls, handbags, apparel, and home textiles with patterns inspired by Thai culture, flora, and architecture, including collaborations with designers like Sarran.

## Key Topics

- Thai silk
- Silk twill
- Luxury scarves and shawls
- Heritage craftsmanship
- Jim Thompson House
- Sarran collaboration
- Arun Collection
- Ikat patterns
- Pima cotton
- Silk chenille
- Thai-inspired prints
- Handwoven textiles
- Peranakan design
- Women's accessories
- Luxury fashion
